lockscreenControl.name: Lock screen control animation
lockscreenControl.description: Animate lock screen control button expansion and collapse. Disabling completes the current size transition immediately.
lockscreenControl.description[zh_CN]: 控制锁屏按钮展开和收缩动画；关闭时立即完成当前尺寸过渡。

windowOpen.name: Window open animation
windowOpen.description: Animate normal window opening. Disabling opens the window immediately.
windowOpen.description[zh_CN]: 控制普通窗口打开动画；关闭时窗口立即显示。

windowClose.name: Window close animation
windowClose.description: Animate normal window closing. Disabling closes the window immediately.
windowClose.description[zh_CN]: 控制普通窗口关闭动画；关闭时窗口立即关闭。

launchpadOpen.name: Launcher open animation
launchpadOpen.description: Animate launcher layer surface opening. Disabling shows it immediately.
launchpadOpen.description[zh_CN]: 控制启动器图层打开动画；关闭时立即显示。

launchpadClose.name: Launcher close animation
launchpadClose.description: Animate launcher layer surface closing. Disabling hides it immediately.
launchpadClose.description[zh_CN]: 控制启动器图层关闭动画；关闭时立即隐藏。

layerShellOpen.name: Layer shell open animation
layerShellOpen.description: Animate anchored layer shell surfaces opening. Disabling shows them immediately.
layerShellOpen.description[zh_CN]: 控制贴边图层窗口打开动画；关闭时立即显示。

layerShellClose.name: Layer shell close animation
layerShellClose.description: Animate anchored layer shell surfaces closing. Disabling hides them immediately.
layerShellClose.description[zh_CN]: 控制贴边图层窗口关闭动画；关闭时立即隐藏。

maximize.name: Maximize animation
maximize.description: Animate the geometry change when maximizing. Disabling applies the maximized geometry immediately.
maximize.description[zh_CN]: 控制最大化几何变化动画；关闭时立即应用最大化几何。

fullscreen.name: Fullscreen animation
fullscreen.description: Animate the geometry change when entering fullscreen. Disabling applies the fullscreen geometry immediately.
fullscreen.description[zh_CN]: 控制进入全屏的几何变化动画；关闭时立即应用全屏几何。

restoreWindow.name: Restore window animation
restoreWindow.description: Animate the geometry change when restoring from maximized or fullscreen. Disabling applies the restored geometry immediately.
restoreWindow.description[zh_CN]: 控制从最大化或全屏还原的几何变化动画；关闭时立即应用还原几何。

splashTransition.name: Splash transition animation
splashTransition.description: Animate the transition from the prelaunch splash to the real window. Disabling shows the real window immediately.
splashTransition.description[zh_CN]: 控制预启动闪屏到真实窗口的过渡动画；关闭时立即显示真实窗口。

minimize.name: Minimize animation
minimize.description: Animate minimizing a window. Disabling minimizes immediately without the shrink transition.
minimize.description[zh_CN]: 控制窗口最小化动画；关闭时立即最小化，不播放缩小过渡。

restoreMinimized.name: Restore minimized animation
restoreMinimized.description: Animate restoring a minimized window. Disabling restores immediately.
restoreMinimized.description[zh_CN]: 控制最小化窗口的恢复动画；关闭时立即恢复。

showDesktop.name: Show desktop animation
showDesktop.description: Animate hiding windows when showing the desktop. Disabling hides them immediately.
showDesktop.description[zh_CN]: 控制显示桌面时隐藏窗口的动画；关闭时立即隐藏。

restoreShowDesktop.name: Restore from desktop animation
restoreShowDesktop.description: Animate restoring windows when leaving show-desktop. Disabling restores them immediately.
restoreShowDesktop.description[zh_CN]: 控制退出显示桌面时恢复窗口的动画；关闭时立即恢复。

launchpadCover.name: Launcher cover animation
launchpadCover.description: Animate the launcher cover wallpaper zoom and fade. Disabling applies the final state immediately.
launchpadCover.description[zh_CN]: 控制启动器覆盖层的壁纸缩放与淡入淡出；关闭时立即应用最终状态。

wallpaperScale.name: Wallpaper scale animation
wallpaperScale.description: Animate wallpaper scaling on launcher and lock screen transitions. Disabling applies the target scale immediately.
wallpaperScale.description[zh_CN]: 控制启动器和锁屏切换时的壁纸缩放动画；关闭时立即应用目标缩放。

workspaceSwitch.name: Workspace switch animation
workspaceSwitch.description: Animate sliding between workspaces. Disabling switches workspaces immediately.
workspaceSwitch.description[zh_CN]: 控制工作区之间的滑动切换动画；关闭时立即切换。

workspaceVisibility.name: Workspace visibility animation
workspaceVisibility.description: Animate the workspace scale and opacity on lock screen entry and exit. Disabling applies the final scale and opacity immediately.
workspaceVisibility.description[zh_CN]: 控制锁屏进入和退出时工作区的缩放与透明度动画；关闭时立即应用最终缩放和透明度。

workspaceBounce.name: Workspace edge bounce animation
workspaceBounce.description: Animate the bounce when switching past the first or last workspace. Disabling skips the bounce.
workspaceBounce.description[zh_CN]: 控制切换到首个或最后一个工作区时的边界回弹动画；关闭时不播放回弹。

taskSwitcher.name: Task switcher mask animation
taskSwitcher.description: Animate the Alt-Tab overlay mask fading. Disabling applies the mask opacity immediately.
taskSwitcher.description[zh_CN]: 控制 Alt-Tab 遮罩淡入淡出；关闭时立即应用遮罩透明度。

taskSwitcherPanel.name: Task switcher panel animation
taskSwitcherPanel.description: Animate the Alt-Tab switcher panel sliding in and out. Disabling shows and hides it immediately.
taskSwitcherPanel.description[zh_CN]: 控制 Alt-Tab 切换面板的滑入滑出；关闭时立即显示或隐藏。

taskSwitcherThumbnail.name: Task switcher thumbnail animation
taskSwitcherThumbnail.description: Animate window thumbnails when switching items in Alt-Tab. Disabling switches thumbnails immediately.
taskSwitcherThumbnail.description[zh_CN]: 控制 Alt-Tab 缩略图切换动画；关闭时立即切换缩略图。

taskSwitcherExit.name: Task switcher exit animation
taskSwitcherExit.description: Animate restoring real windows when leaving Alt-Tab. Disabling restores them immediately.
taskSwitcherExit.description[zh_CN]: 控制退出 Alt-Tab 时真实窗口的恢复动画；关闭时立即恢复。

multitaskviewEnter.name: Multitask view enter animation
multitaskviewEnter.description: Animate entering the multitask view. Disabling shows the final layout immediately.
multitaskviewEnter.description[zh_CN]: 控制进入多任务视图的动画；关闭时立即显示最终布局。

multitaskviewExit.name: Multitask view exit animation
multitaskviewExit.description: Animate leaving the multitask view. Disabling hides it immediately after the exit completes.
multitaskviewExit.description[zh_CN]: 控制退出多任务视图的动画；关闭时退出后立即隐藏。

multitaskviewLayout.name: Multitask view layout animation
multitaskviewLayout.description: Animate window layout and scale changes in the multitask view. Disabling applies the final layout immediately; dragging stays interactive.
multitaskviewLayout.description[zh_CN]: 控制多任务视图中窗口布局与缩放变化；关闭时立即应用最终布局，拖动交互保留。

multitaskviewEmptyHint.name: Multitask view empty hint animation
multitaskviewEmptyHint.name[zh_CN]: 多任务空窗口提示动画
multitaskviewEmptyHint.description: Animate the empty-window hint opacity in the multitask view. Disabling applies the final opacity immediately.
multitaskviewEmptyHint.description[zh_CN]: 控制多任务视图空窗口提示的透明度动画；关闭时立即应用最终透明度。

outputRotation.name: Output rotation animation
outputRotation.description: Animate rotating the primary output. Disabling applies the rotation and transform immediately.
outputRotation.description[zh_CN]: 控制主输出旋转动画；关闭时立即应用旋转和实际 transform。

mirrorOutputRotation.name: Mirror output rotation animation
mirrorOutputRotation.description: Animate rotating a mirror output. Disabling applies the rotation and transform immediately.
mirrorOutputRotation.description[zh_CN]: 控制镜像输出旋转动画；关闭时立即应用旋转和实际 transform。

wallpaperCrossFade.name: Wallpaper cross fade animation
wallpaperCrossFade.description: Cross fade between wallpapers. Disabling switches as soon as the new wallpaper is ready.
wallpaperCrossFade.description[zh_CN]: 控制壁纸之间的交叉渐变；关闭时在新壁纸就绪后立即切换。

loginContent.name: Login content animation
loginContent.name[zh_CN]: 登录内容滑入滑出动画
loginContent.description: Animate lock and login screen content sliding in and out. Disabling shows or hides the content immediately.
loginContent.description[zh_CN]: 控制锁屏和登录界面内容的滑入滑出；关闭时立即显示或隐藏。

greeterBackground.name: Greeter background transition animation
greeterBackground.description: Animate the greeter background scale and dim transitions. Disabling applies the final state immediately.
greeterBackground.description[zh_CN]: 控制登录界面背景缩放与变暗过渡；关闭时立即应用最终状态。
